data.long_meaning: Istekhar is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Ista' meaning 'god' and 'Khar' meaning 'wisdom'. This name is believed to be associated with the Hindu deity Agastya, who is known as the God of Wisdom and Knowledge. The name Istekhar carries the meaning “God of Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Istekhar usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
